verdict.rationale: HubSpot provides both REST APIs (contacts creation via POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts, custom objects API) and an official MCP server giving 'secure read and write access to your HubSpot CRM data — contacts, deals, engagements, and more,' which supports agent-driven record creation and enrichment. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a companies-object API/endpoint or an owner-assignment endpoint/property, and there's no example or workflow showing an agent chaining create+enrich+assign-owner end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit company-object API/owner-assignment endpoint documentation, a demonstrated end-to-end enrichment workflow via API or MCP, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent performing this full sequence.
